reviews.title: TOO MANY ADVERTS !
reviews.text: Advert after advert not good for a tasbeeh app

reviews.title: Awful adds
reviews.text: Annoying and haram adds of women, may Allah guide the creators of the app. It never use to have adds now this ruins it completely. Don’t recommend.

reviews.title: None stop advertising
reviews.text: This was a brilliant app when first launched. Now it’s ads none stop which is frustrating. So have no options but to delete the app move to another app.

reviews.title: Amazing UI Horrible Ads
reviews.text: The UI is amazing and the haptic feedback plus design is really nice. Whats so annoying is the amount of ads forcibly shown when resetting. Some of the ads are inappropriate too showing suggestive pictures. Ask for donations but don’t show ads like this for Dhikr
